title: DERIVED_VARIABLES — Anthropometric
description: Height, weight, BMI and body-circumference measures derived from the baseline questionnaire.

R0_Height20.title: Height in centimeters at 20 years old.
R0_Height20.x-derivation: Derived from the RecordedHeights entry where R0_RecHght_Num == '20'. Height is set to R0_HghtAge_Cm if it is present and >0; otherwise it is calculated from imperial inputs as R0_HghtAge_Ft*30.48 + R0_HghtAge_In*2.54 when either imperial component is present and the converted value is >0; otherwise null. No discrepancy check is applied when both metric and imperial values are present.
R0_Height20.$comment: Source lists R0_RecWght_Num where its derivation text says R0_RecHght_Num [sic]. Former name: bodysizeht20. 9999 has no stated trigger in the source, so no rule is attached (D016).

R0_Weight20.title: Weight in kilograms at 20 years old.
R0_Weight20.x-derivation: Derived from the RecordedWeights entry where R0_RecWght_Num == '20'. Weight is set to R0_WghtAge_Kg if it is present and >0; otherwise it is calculated from imperial inputs as R0_WghtAge_St*6.35029318 + R0_WghtAge_Lbs*0.45359237 when either imperial component is present and the converted value is >0; otherwise null. No discrepancy check is applied when both metric and imperial values are present.
R0_Weight20.$comment: Former name: weight_20. 9999 has no stated trigger in the source, so no rule is attached (D016).

R0_BMI20.title: BMI at 20 years old.
R0_BMI20.x-derivation: Body Mass Index (kg/m²) at age 20. If AgeEntry < 20 or R0_PregAt20 == 1, BMI is set to 9999. Otherwise BMI is calculated as R0_Weight20 / ((R0_Height20 / 100)^2) when both derived measures are present and >0; otherwise null. BMI is rounded to 1 decimal place.
R0_BMI20.$comment: Source description has a trailing space, trimmed in title. Calculation: R0_Weight20 / ((R0_Height20 / 100) ^ 2). Former name: bmi_20. Rule R001 applies (skip and applicability; the AgeEntry < 20 half is not enforceable, D013).

R0_Height.title: Height in centimeters at baseline.
R0_Height.x-derivation: Derived from current height inputs in PhysicalDevelopment. Height is set to R0_CurrentHght_Cm if it is present and >0; otherwise it is calculated from imperial inputs as R0_CurrentHght_Ft*30.48 + R0_CurrentHght_In*2.54 when either imperial component is present and the converted value is >0; otherwise null. No discrepancy check is applied when both metric and imperial values are present.

R0_Weight.title: Weight in kilograms at baseline.
R0_Weight.x-derivation: Derived from current weight inputs in PhysicalDevelopment. Weight is set to R0_CurrentWght_Kg if it is present and >0; otherwise it is calculated from imperial inputs as R0_CurrentWght_St*6.35029318 + R0_CurrentWght_Lbs*0.45359237 when either imperial component is present and the converted value is >0; otherwise null. No discrepancy check is applied when both metric and imperial values are present.

R0_BMI.title: BMI at baseline.
R0_BMI.x-derivation: Body Mass Index (kg/m²) at baseline. If R0_CurrentPreg == 1, BMI is set to 9999. Otherwise BMI is calculated as weight_kg / (height_m^2) using derived R0_Weight and R0_Height when both are present and >0; otherwise null. BMI is rounded to 1 decimal place.
R0_BMI.x-universe: Participants not pregnant at baseline (R0_PregAtEntry = 0); 9999 for those who were.
R0_BMI.$comment: Calculation: R0_Weight / ((R0_Height / 100) ^ 2). Former name: bmi_entry. Rule R002 applies (skip and applicability, D023).

R0_HighestWeight.title: Greatest non-pregnant weight since age 18 (kg).
R0_HighestWeight.x-derivation: Derived from greatest non-pregnant weight since age 18 in PhysicalDevelopment. Weight is set to R0_HighestWght_Kg if it is present and >0; otherwise it is calculated from imperial inputs as R0_HighestWght_St*6.35029318 + R0_HighestWght_Lbs*0.45359237 when either imperial component is present and the converted value is >0; otherwise null.

R0_HighestWeightAge.title: Age at greatest non-pregnant weight since age 18, in whole years.

R0_WaistCircum.title: Waist circumference in centimeters at baseline.
R0_WaistCircum.x-derivation: Derived from waist circumference inputs in PhysicalDevelopment. Waist circumference is calculated from R0_WaistCircum_In*2.54 when inches is present and >0; otherwise R0_WaistCircum_Cm is used when present and >0; otherwise null. The selected value is rounded to 2 decimal places.

R0_HipCircum.title: Hip circumference in centimeters at baseline.
R0_HipCircum.x-derivation: Derived from hip circumference inputs in PhysicalDevelopment. Hip circumference is calculated from R0_HipCircum_In*2.54 when inches is present and >0; otherwise R0_HipCircum_Cm is used when present and >0; otherwise null. The selected value is rounded to 2 decimal places.

R0_WaistHipRatio.title: Waist-to-hip ratio at baseline.
R0_WaistHipRatio.x-derivation: Waist-to-hip ratio at baseline. If R0_CurrentPreg == 1, the value is set to 9999. Otherwise it is calculated as R0_WaistCircum / R0_HipCircum when both derived measurements are present and R0_HipCircum > 0; otherwise null. The ratio is rounded to 2 decimal places.
R0_WaistHipRatio.x-universe: Participants not pregnant at baseline (R0_PregAtEntry = 0); 9999 for those who were.
R0_WaistHipRatio.$comment: Calculation: R0_WaistCircum / R0_HipCircum. Former name: bodysizewhr. Rule R002 applies (skip and applicability, D023).

$comment: Soft checks: R0_BMI20 = R0_Weight20 / (R0_Height20 / 100)^2 and R0_BMI = R0_Weight / (R0_Height / 100)^2, each rounded to 1 decimal place; R0_WaistHipRatio = R0_WaistCircum / R0_HipCircum, rounded to 2 decimal places (D018).
